purpose: Implement and test public BDH-GPU inference-cell algebra as bounded recurrent synaptic state in the existing AXON runtime. A separate associative-memory assay compares frozen, additive Hebbian and normalized delta correction. Neither assay certifies language, abstract reasoning, M1 or BDH-CQ replication.
reference: One-head vector-input cell: layer norm, positive expanded neuron activations, strictly past rotary linear attention, positive value expansion, multiplicative gate, low-rank decoding and normalized residual. Shared slow weights across depth. No byte embeddings/language head, dropout or end-to-end slow-weight training in this phase. Quantized seeded projections are provided untrained priors. Compare with independent dense-prefix JavaScript arithmetic using the exact exported dequantized coefficients, including future-input prefix-invariance and chunk/restore equivalence.
extension: Association assay uses the same positive key expansion and finite fast matrix, no rotary phase or sequence-cell gating. Additive S+=eta*k*v and normalized delta S+=eta*k*(v-S^T*k), ||k||2=1; frozen writes nothing. Delta is an AXON fast-weight extension with published antecedents, NOT the original BDH rule. No hardcoded key-answer table in the neural model. A literal nearest-neighbor control may beat or equal it and must be reported.

assay.feedback_order: Prediction first, explicit observation then later queries. Initial random label permutations; later corrections deliberately change a previously repeated association. Same keys, values, noise and event order across rules for a gene. Measure exact observed-key recall, perturbed-key recall and old/new recall after correction; new queries around an observed key are perturbation transfer, NOT unseen semantic concepts.

engineering.scope: Count decoded payload, state, transactional scratch and model working arrays separately from RSS/process/JSON/IO/observer. No cap increase to rescue a failed configuration. No energy claim. All error paths preserve caller state; private checkpoints explicit and never included in fresh genomic birth.

acceptance: Reference arithmetic and causal/chunk parity within1e-4 absolute+relative tolerance for every compared vector; no cross-scope/model/mode resume; corruption, unknown fields, unavailable quotas and clobber refused; fixed-size contextual state independent of stream length at fixed geometry; fresh child state zero. All associative outcomes and controls published, no score-selected retries. Engineering success is not an intelligence or M1 gate.
regression: Focused/full Rust, clippy, minimal build, JS, inherited public language outputs and exact legacy-pointer session replay with current binary. No UI edits or fabricated telemetry. Preserve pre-existing experimental attention reader; do not claim it is BDH.
